reasoning_traces.think:
The core innovation lies in modeling each time slice independently through an implicit radiance field F_t(x,d; Θ_t), which encodes both color and density of the scene. This allows for novel-view synthesis without requiring explicit 3D geometry. The use of a multiresolution hash encoding γ ensures efficient representation of high-frequency spatial details. Volume rendering integrates these fields along rays to produce photorealistic images. Temporal independence avoids assumptions of smooth motion, aligning with fast-paced sports dynamics. However, this approach lacks predictive modeling capabilities and does not support tabular sports analytics. The method's reliance on synchronized cameras and known camera poses limits its applicability to real-world betting scenarios. The absence of temporal coupling implies that future predictions cannot be made directly from the model’s outputs, making it unsuitable for GSI’s forecasting tasks.
